items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: Quincy would go and get into his writing thing. He was talking about getting a small group together, and I thought I was going to be working with that group. Because these were the people I was very comfortable with on a personal level as well as a musical level.

ctx.x: ...some kind of arrangements that they would be released after we were gone, or anything. But Quincy and Art Farmer and Gigi Gryce, who were very talented and had a possibility of exposing their things in their little jazz world, where Hamp wasn't in it...And I just felt it was only fair that he should allow them the opportunity to do that, because we were working with Hamp at the lowest prices and the worst conditions. Give a guy a chance to get something going somewhere else...
Did you do some of those?
